about: A person's review of the sweep's leads for cycle 2026-11-28 (data/funding/candidates/sweep-2026-11-28.json). 'found' means a listing from this organisation was written up and passed, or was sent to, the source check; 'none' means the leads were read and none was a current opportunity with direct or related heat relevance (or a reviewed network-tier role). Applied to data/funding/coverage.json by review.js.
